market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Global grey & ductile iron castings market: $120.7B (2024) to $212.4B by 2032 (6.5%/yr) per one vendor, vs. a materially smaller $49.32B (2024) to $80.53B by 2033 (5.9%/yr) per another — ~2.4x discrepancy, likely reflecting different scope definitions (raw castings vs. finished cast components). India accounted for 12.1% of the global iron-casting market in 2025; India segment CAGR 8.4% (2026-2033), projected to reach $28,412.1M by 2033 — the fastest-growing APAC sub-market.
market.domesticSlice: Kirloskar Ferrous Industries (listed) posted ₹6,564.23 Cr FY25 standalone net sales (+6.8% YoY), PAT ₹294.04 Cr, ~11.7% 3-yr average ROE. Nelcast Ltd (listed) posted ₹1,251.7 Cr FY25 revenue, improving to ₹1,342.4 Cr FY26 (+5.8% YoY) with PAT margin improving to 9.3% — India's largest jobbing foundry for ductile/grey iron, 160,000 MT/year capacity, >36% of revenue from exports.

structureFacts: PED 2014/68/EU certification is a specific EU regulatory gate for pressure-equipment castings (pumps/valves/oil&gas use cases), differentiating suppliers who can serve EU industrial-equipment OEMs
Rising raw-material (pig iron, scrap, coke) and energy costs are a persistent industry margin pressure, compounded during periods of geopolitical disruption to logistics/petrochemical-linked inputs
Larger listed players (Kirloskar Ferrous, Nelcast) increasingly integrate iron-making with casting to buffer input-cost volatility — a capability smaller/regional foundries typically lack

adoptionStructure.note: Zero-defect quality commitment, regulatory/pressure-equipment certification (PED) for oil&gas/hydraulics/pumps&valves customers, NPD collaboration capability (3D modeling/2D drawing/tooling design), and capacity/lead-time reliability drive vendor selection.

steps: offer finished/machined grey iron, ductile iron, and alloy cast-iron castings
serve automotive, industrial, energy, oil&gas, mining, hydraulics, construction, pumps&valves end markets
run customer engineering collaboration (3D modeling → 2D drawing → tooling/manufacturing design)
pass PED/ISO audit and certification checkpoints for regulated end-uses
run melting/moulding production (green sand, high-pressure moulding lines) sized in TPA
manage raw-material (pig iron, scrap, alloying elements) availability, especially under supply shocks
maintain long-term supply agreements with automotive/industrial OEMs
handle export logistics to multiple countries
fulfil OEM supply volumes tied to underlying vehicle/equipment production schedules
expand capacity as a forward bet on order-book growth
